description: MInistry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment to the Medical Service Minute of Sri Lankan Health Service Published in Gazette Ex. Ord. No. 1883/17 of 11.10.2014
reasoning: This gazette contains an amendment to the Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service, which outlines public service positions, grades, designations, and qualification requirements within the health service. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals specifically with public sector service structure and administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
